description: Use when you are about to use or recommend a product and need to know if an agent can work it on its own: send its slug from search_tools, or its name or domain. Returns its drive result: agent level (0-5), where our agent stopped, what it can and can't do, how it gets in and pays; only its API, MCP and CLI: get_agent_surfaces. Read-only, no key needed; the headline unless brief is false.

brief.description: true (default here): the headline, 2.5 to 5 KB; false: the full record, 13 to 35 KB

slug.description: The product's directory slug from search_tools (e.g. 'attio'), or its name or domain

name: get_provider
title: Get one product's drive result
